name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a step-by-step checklist, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own look that you can read and steer, kept up to date, with the build's progress on it), build with one agent or several in parallel, make or remix multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, give games sound effects and synthesized music made on your own computer for free, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make covers and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, playtest a game on a computer and a phone with measured checks and a blind review, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal under a budget with receipts), run the studio's site (the same sections as homie.rocks in the studio's own look, an epic landing page for every game, news posts with feeds) and public rooms (up to 32 players a room, shareable from the play page) on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), list it in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats (counts, never tracking), and run its live games from a back office (who is playing now, in-game announcements, kick and mute, close a room, players per room, private / invite-only beta / public launch states with invite codes, and a remix switch; the owner confirms anything that takes something away with one tap). Beta.
